title: A gym plan the phone cannot read is marked 'No longer sent', though the gym still sends it
what: When the gym sends its plans, any plan this phone cannot read (for example one saved in a newer format than an older app understands) is quietly dropped from the list. The phone then treats that plan as taken away: its folder is relabelled 'No longer sent by <gym>' and stops getting the trainer's updates, while the panel shows the plan as still given to the member.
expected: A plan the phone cannot read leaves its folder as it was (still from the gym), and the app notes the read problem, so the phone and the panel agree on which plans the member has.
how_often: only when a gym plan fails to read on that phone
fix_line: Keep the ids of plans that could not be read and never mark those folders as no longer sent
